description: DemoTask is a wholly fictional, synthetic productivity/task-list Android app authored solely for AdForge platform acceptance testing. It has no real users, no App Store listing, and no connection to any real company or product. It exists only to prove AdForge can run one complete autonomous campaign end to end.
approved_features: Lets you add a task to a fictional list
Lets you mark a fictional task complete
prohibited_claims: Guarantees you will never miss a deadline
Collects or stores any real personal data
known_limitations: All data is synthetic and does not persist between fresh installs
Not published to any app store
privacy_claims: Collects no real personal data because it is a synthetic test app with no backend
audiences: Busy professionals (fictional persona, for creative-copy purposes only)

demo_workflows.name: Add a fictional task
demo_workflows.steps: Open the app, tap Add, enter a fictional task name, save.

demo_workflows.name: Mark a fictional task complete
demo_workflows.steps: Tap the checkbox next to an existing fictional task.

evidence.claim: Lets you add a task to a fictional list
Lets you mark a fictional task complete
